item.title: Senate Blocks Bid to Cancel Arms Sales to Israel as Iran War Deepens Democratic Divide
item.summary: Concerns over the Iran war led several Democratic senators who had rejected past bids to curb weapons transfers to Israel to vote to block the sale of bulldozers and bombs.

item.title: Trump’s Portrayal of the War in Iran Collides With Reality
item.summary: President Trump is confronting a crisis that is not bending to his narrative of a “pretty reasonable” new regime in Iran and all-but-assured victory for the United States.

item.title: Pakistani Mediators Arrive in Tehran in Bid to Keep U.S.-Iran Peace Talks Alive
item.summary: The diplomacy came as the U.S. Navy locked down trade to Iranian ports, and Iran responded by threatening critical shipping routes across the region.

item.title: With Iran War on Pause, Political Battle Resumes Over Israeli Democracy
item.summary: A court fight over Itamar Ben-Gvir, an extremist who oversees the police, pits the attorney general against Benjamin Netanyahu and his right-wing government.

item.title: Senate Republicans Again Block Bid to Limit Trump’s Iran War Powers
item.summary: For the fourth time since the war began, G.O.P. senators successfully fended off an effort to constrain the president. But there were signs of growing unease among Republicans.

item.title: Israel Considering Cease-Fire With Lebanon, Officials Say
item.summary: Talk of a truce that would pause the war between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon followed rare direct talks between Israel and Lebanon in Washington on Tuesday.

item.title: Kuwait Detained Journalist After Comments on Iran War Images, Watchdog Says
item.summary: The country has not commented publicly about Ahmed Shihab-Eldin, who the Committee to Protect Journalists said had been charged with spreading false information.

item.title: Iran-Linked Ships Slow or Stop as U.S. Navy Enforces Strait of Hormuz Blockade
item.summary: More than a dozen U.S. Navy warships are enforcing a blockade on all vessels from all nations entering or leaving coastal areas or ports in Iran.

item.title: Here’s how the U.S. blockade of Iranian shipping is taking shape.
item.summary: The military’s blockade of Iranian ports aims to suppress sea traffic to and from Iran, while leaving the strait itself open.

item.title: Rubio Hosts Israel and Lebanon for Rare Meeting Shadowed by U.S.-Iran War
item.summary: The gathering ended with encouraging words, even as Israel continued to refuse to halt its military campaign against Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon.
